{{Top|leg}}
An '''acceleration facility''' was a technology used by [[the Colony]] to assist in transforming individuals into [[Joiner]]s. Found on the planets of the [[Utegetu Nebula/Legends|Utegetu Nebula]], many of the beings sent here were criminals who were set to work for the [[Gorog]].
